SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, (wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32) as wtmp_f 
FROM pier 
WHERE ts_doy >= 210
ORDER BY ts_t DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 206 AND 213
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls

SELECT 
  fish_date_season,
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 284 AND 300
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC, fish_date_doy, cls
